'''Sayur bayam''' or '''sayur bening''' is an [[Indonesian cuisine|Indonesian]] [[vegetable soup]] prepared from vegetables, primarily [[amaranth]], in clear soup flavoured with ''[[temu kunci]]''. It is commonly prepared as a main course during breakfast or [[Lunch|lunchtime]].
